title: What is check?
objectives: Recognize when a king is in check
Find a move that puts the opponent in check

steps.text: A king is in check when it's under direct attack from an enemy piece. Check isn't the end of the game — it's a warning: you must get out of check on your very next move.

steps.prompt: Click the square your rook could move to that would put the black king in check.

feedback.default: Not check. The rook needs a clear line straight to the black king — which square lines up with it?

steps.prompt: If your king is in check, what must you do on your next move?
options: Nothing — check is just a suggestion
Get out of check, no matter what

feedback.default: Check is mandatory to answer — you can't make a move that leaves your own king in check.

steps.summary: Check means the king is under attack and must escape immediately. Next: what happens when there's no way out.
